correctness.rationale: Direct Gaussian KL reduction gives an explicitly differentiable scalar objective; strict posterior quadratic variance proves convexity in every full symmetric precision direction, coercivity follows from sigma>0, and sign-group averaging forces a diagonal minimizer. Matrix and scalar numerical tests reproduced every tested identity; finite checks are supplementary.
